items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Like Arthur Lee Simpkins was one of the finest vocalists ever, but he never really recorded.

ctx.x: Yeah. I think I have some of those old home records now, and I just made them at home, you know, just to hear how my material, stuff, would sound. You know. And I said, "No, I've never recorded for anyone." And he said he had heard something of mine. My brother Joe had taken some little things, little home records or something, you know, up there for him to hear, and he didn't particularly care for what he heard, you know, on the record, but he said, "I like you.
